pages.title: Paleolama
pages.text: The Paleolama ($(o)Palaeolama mirifica$()) is an extinct llama-like camelid that lived in the southern United States during the Pleistocene, especially in Florida.$(br2)Often called the stout-legged llama, it had shorter, sturdier limbs than living llamas and was considerably heavier.$(br2)It is thought to have been a browser, feeding on leaves and shrubs in wooded habitats.
